text:
Situation: Ceftriaxone sodium inventory is low across Corvale sites. Corvale East has 19.6 days on hand, Corvale General has 18 days, and Corvale Lakeside has 8.8 days. Corvale East and Corvale Lakeside stock NDC 70518249900 labeled by REMEDYREPACK INC. and manufactured at the SANDOZ plant, linked as sponsor only. Corvale General carries that NDC plus NDC 71205059301 from Proficient Rx LP.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show Proficient Rx LP (FEI 3011557028) received VAI classifications on 2015-10-22 (inspection 948193) and 2022-12-08. The SANDOZ plant is listed as sponsor only. No OAI actions or supply disruptions are recorded for these facilities. Ceftriaxone sodium is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Internal supply is uneven. Corvale Lakeside is at risk of stockout within nine days. No FDA shortage listing or enforcement actions explain the low inventory. External suppliers show availability.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 22 vials from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside. Approval: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 22 vials from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside. Approval: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
3. Purchase from Civica, Inc. Approval: Buyer.
4. Purchase from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC. Approval: Buyer.
5. Purchase from Sandoz Inc. Approval: Buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary alterations at this time.
